title: Sex Positions
summary: Sex positions are the ways partners arrange their bodies during sex. Common ones include missionary (face to face, one on top), partner-on-top (cowgirl), from behind (doggy style) and side-by-side (spooning).
key_points: The 'best' position is whatever is comfortable and enjoyable for both.
Pillows and pace changes help comfort; some positions suit pregnancy, back pain or deeper/shallower penetration.
answer_guidance: Name and describe positions briefly and non-graphically. Focus on comfort and communication.
